caption_editorial: Brick, stone, and lamplight at dusk. The Majestic at Pine Woods pairs a main-floor primary suite and library with a flexible upstairs loft. Move in now. Comment {{KEYWORD}} for details.
caption_lifestyle: Coffee at the island, quiet evenings in a primary suite down the hall, movie nights in the upstairs bonus room. The Majestic at Pine Woods lives easy on one level, with space to grow.
caption_feature: Main-floor primary suite with tray ceiling. Main-floor library. Two more first-level bedrooms. Upstairs loft + bonus room. 3-car garage. Immediate occupancy at 3093 Raffler Dr. DM TOUR
first_comment_hook: That wrought-iron ring chandelier in the great room or the stone gable with the arched entry out front: which detail would make you pull into the driveway first?
alt_text: Photo 1: Dusk exterior of The Majestic, a brick home with a stacked-stone center gable, arched recessed entry, warm light glowing through tall front windows, a three-car garage with two carriage-style doors, boulder-accented landscaping, a young tree, and a deep blue and orange sky. Photo 2: Open kitchen and dining area with gray shaker cabinets, white subway tile backsplash, gas cooktop, a center island with three leather counter stools, glass pendant lights, a drum pendant over a walnut dining table, and floor-to-ceiling windows with linen drapes overlooking evergreens. Photo 3: Great room with a ring candle-style chandelier and tall windows, opening through a wide cased doorway to a dining nook with a round pedestal table and the kitchen beyond, with wide-plank wood floors and a hallway leading to the right. Photo 4: Primary suite with a tray ceiling, upholstered bed dressed in sage velvet and a cable-knit throw, a backlit floating shelf, a window framed by taupe drapes looking out to green trees, and a wood media console. Photo 5: Main-floor home office seen through an open paneled door, with a walnut executive desk, leather chair, wall clock, floating shelf, and a large window overlooking an open green landscape.

reel_script.0-2s: Slow push-in on the dusk exterior: glowing windows, brick-and-stone gable, arched entry. Text: 'The Majestic · Pine Woods · Move in now.'
reel_script.2-5s: Cut inside under the ring chandelier, glide through the cased opening toward the dining nook and kitchen. Text: 'Open great room → kitchen + dining nook.'
reel_script.5-8s: Smooth pan across the island, gray shaker cabinetry, and glass pendants, ending on the wooded view through the sliders. Text: 'Built for gathering.'
reel_script.8-10s: Quick cuts: primary suite tray ceiling and sage bedding, then the office door swinging open to the walnut desk. Text: 'Primary suite + library, all on the main floor.'
reel_script.10-12s: Reveal shot climbing toward the upstairs loft/bonus room, then end card. Text: 'Loft + bonus room upstairs. 3093 Raffler Dr. DM TOUR.'
